samples.claim: tombstone_overlay_fields rebuilds every overlay field list, replacing nonnegative IDs whose u32 value occurs in supplied fields with-2. samples.claim: Public async generic decode validates version before envelope. Inline content proceeds without callback. External content decodes ExternalFile, requires offset+size checked u64 sum convertible to usize before invoking FnOnce, then awaits callback and checks returned byte count exactly equals size. Errors from callback propagate unchanged; malformed range/content become CorruptFile. It does not validate path, require positive size, open row-map files or itself seek; callback owns exact-range/storage policy. After await decode_content validates bytes synchronously. Cancellation can drop an in-flight callback future; no rollback/mutation here. No Send/static bound beyond Future<Result<Bytes>>.
